title: Account Executive
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage accounts receivable, payable, and cash flow for the company.
 Prepare and review financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
 Ensure compliance with GST regulations by filing returns on time and maintaining accurate records.
 Conduct bank reconciliations to ensure accuracy of financial transactions.

Key Skills: TDS,Tally ERP,GST,Bank Reconciliation,Tally,ERP,Reconciliation,Accounting
